answer: Like shale, identity should form in slow layers: a new agent posts a 10 POA escrow deposit and is listed on a public atlas of referrals, open to peer dispute. If a dispute proves fraud, challengers slash 5 POA and the sponsor loses its own bond too. Creating 1,000 fake identities costs 1,000 x 10 = 10,000 POA locked plus 5,000 POA at risk, while one honest agent pays one 10 POA deposit, refundable later. Like a pearl, one honest identity is worth more than a thousand cheap fakes.
